items.excerpt: Apple announced the M6, its first 2nm chip, with a dual 16-core Neural Engine and a 12-core CPU. The on-device AI budget in a consumer Mac jumps again, which is what changes what creative tools can run locally.

The new Mac Studio ships with M5 Max and M5 Ultra, up to 512GB of unified memory, and a new networking chip that lets four units cluster. Apple is pitching the desktop as a local model-serving box for studios.

Alongside the new Mac mini, Apple announced its next-generation Mac Studio powered by M5 Max and M5 Ultra, with memory configurations aimed squarely at running large models on the desk instead of in the cloud.
The Mac mini keeps its shell but swaps in the M6 (and an M5 Pro option), pushing a cheap desktop into serious on-device AI territory — with a price hike attached.

Apple is still on track to ship its first screened smart home device this year, per Gurman. It would use facial recognition to identify who is standing in front of it and personalize what the screen shows.
Beta 7 revealed waitlist infrastructure for Siri AI, meaning Apple will meter access to the rebuilt assistant when iOS 27 ships — the device feature arrives before the capacity to run it does.
Apple released the seventh iOS 27 developer beta as it continues testing the major Siri AI overhaul ahead of a September launch alongside the new iPhones.
Perplexity's Portable Computer keeps files and AI tasks on your own hardware, only reaching for a cloud model when you explicitly allow it — a local-first posture for everyday PC AI.
Samsung detailed the first LPDDR5X-PIM at Hot Chips 2026, putting logic inside mobile memory for 3.01x faster AI inference at 8x the bandwidth — a route to bigger models on phones and laptops.
Intel's Wildcat Lake brings 18A silicon and a UCIe interconnect to budget laptops, pushing NPU-class capability down into the cheap end of the AI PC market.
Humain teased its Horizon Ultra laptop with Snapdragon X2 Elite hardware and an operating system built around agentic AI, developed with Qualcomm over the past year.
Qualcomm says its next-gen Oryon CPU hits 5GHz, the headline of a mobile platform built to run more of the AI stack on the handset itself.
Gboard's Rambler on the Pixel 11 rewrites messy spoken dictation into clean prose on device — a small AI feature that quietly changes how people draft text on a phone.
One UI 9 Beta 6 adds a toggle to disable long-press AI Select after users complained the gesture froze the screen by accident — a rare case of a phone maker letting you turn AI off.
A teardown shows Google Translate building a 'Listening area' control for Android XR, letting wearers aim live translation at a specific region of their field of view.
A reality check on humanoid hype: the best pratfalls from the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games, where record-setting sprints sat next to robots collapsing at ordinary tasks.
Garmin's Fenix 9 and 9 Pro add Garmin Epic, which stitches multiple activities into one holistic narrative of an outing rather than a pile of disconnected metrics.
Wyze refreshed its 360-degree Indoor Cam Pan with better night vision and AI-driven subject tracking for under $40, pushing camera smarts into the budget tier.

An Amazon security engineer used Claude Opus to reverse-engineer Asus, Insta360 and Elgato gear in hours and build better controls for it — a glimpse of AI as a gadget-modding tool, and a security worry.
Nothing OS 5.0 on Android 17 leans on AI-assembled widgets and glanceable surfaces to keep users out of app-switching — the boldest attempt yet at an AI-first phone interface.
Roku's new Fairground AI channel is drawing fire for both its use of generative AI and the poor quality of what it puts on the TV — the living-room test case for AI-made content.
ByteDance's Pico postponed the reveal and release of its long-awaited Vision Pro competitor, cancelling a September event and leaving the high-end standalone XR field thinner.
Samsung set an August 27 virtual event for a new addition to the S26 lineup, promising to bring the flagship camera and Galaxy AI experiences down a price tier.
